All six fixes applied and verified. Report follows.

**Fixes applied (all as specified, no redesign):**

1. `/Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/skills/git/SKILL.md` — new "Shell Working Directory" section after the Atomic Command Rule: never bare `cd` for zip/subdirectory ops, always `(cd dir && zip ...)`, with the subshell-vs-chaining note and err-20260829T161002-X7JBHO reference. Mirrors the SYSTEM.md guard (which I confirmed is already present under "Capability Verification and Execution Guards").

2. `/Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/agents/chase.md` — rule added in the system-block Data Requirements area: vault-resident files (Mind/, systems/, vault-synced folders) must use Obsidian MCP write tools, never the Write tool; Write tool is workspace deliverables only.

3. `systems/eval-harness/new-eval.py` — added `--name`, `--agent`, `--session-id` (dest `session_id`) CLI args; `skeleton()` now takes identity overrides. Verified: fields populate at creation, `--help` exposes all three, `--id-only` unchanged.

4. `systems/eval-harness/record-step.py` — `find_most_recent_eval_record()` now matches only `status == "in-progress"`, sorts on parsed `started` datetime (Z normalized, unparseable falls back deterministically, ties broken by filename), and on no exact match prints a loud stderr message with remediation guidance and exits 1 instead of silently continuing.

5. `systems/eval-harness/guardrail-checkpoint.py` — same `parse_started` + parsed-datetime sort applied to its lookup (in-progress filter was already there); retry/warn behavior preserved.

6. `systems/eval-harness/grade_skill_run.py` — `find_latest_record()` sorts on parsed `started`, prefers the most recent in-progress record (falls back to most recent closed), and warns to stderr when the chosen record's started date is not today.

**Verification:** behavioral tests against a temp fixture directory covering the exact reported failure modes — fractional-seconds in-progress record now beats a same-second closed record (the GNRQ9D inversion), no-match exits 1 with stderr (confirmed end-to-end against the real runs dir), stale-date warning fires for a Sept-1 record and stays silent for today's, in-progress preferred over a later-dated closed record. All passed. Live confirmation: the grader run just now selected today's record (eval-20260917T234127-EWP9N0) with no stale warning.

**salience-score.py verification:** the instruction's claim is correct — `systems/dream-cycle/salience-score.py` was already fixed 2026-09-01. err-20260901T081243-R58BYW carries a Rigby resolution block, and both patches (the `\n?` optional-trailing-newline regex fix and the last-match `promoted` scan) are present in the current file. Not touched.

Operational notes: two Bash permission denials occurred mid-run (compound commands containing `rm`); both were rerun via alternate safe commands, nothing blocked.
